title: Escalation days over the full record
definition: One row per day: events recorded, the trailing baseline, the robust z score and whether the day is an escalation day. A day without 7 days of record before it is not evaluated.
notes: Escalation days: 253 of 260 days evaluated; 4 escalation days: 2026-05-27 (361 events against a trailing median of 285.0), 2026-07-08 (370 events against a trailing median of 237.0), 2026-09-01 (408 events against a trailing median of 243.0) and 2026-11-08 (529 events against a trailing median of 282.0). A day is judged against the 7 days before it; days without that history in the record (which begins on 28 Feb 2026) are not evaluated.
